description: What are people saying about this brand or keyword on each platform? Searches one page of posts for a keyword on each platform you pick and lays them out as one table with a platform column: text, author, time and engagement. Use when the user asks this about Douyin, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Bilibili, Weibo, TikTok, X (Twitter), YouTube, Reddit, Kuaishou, Zhihu, WeChat Channels, WeChat Search. 这个品牌或关键词，在各平台上大家在说什么？在你选的每个平台上按关键词搜一页内容，排成一张带平台列的表：正文、作者、时间和互动数据。

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
